Name: Two More Fertile
Author: archello11443
Description:
So many tarot tubers popping out of the digsite, with a river right there .  Now you can plant them on the spot and have a little weedy rocky boney farm .  And have a banana tree waiting beside you when your parrot chariot lands .  And Cindersnap forest seems like a pretty good place to plant lots of rice . 

You can only plant fruit trees on dirt, not grass ...  so there is still space reserved for kegs !

It would be very easy to edit this mod yourself to include more areas .  To do so, open the content JSON in this mod's folder using a program like Notepad++ or Visual Studio .  Then, under "Fields", write the location you wish fertility upon, with CanPlantHere.  Your syntax must be precise .  Try to follow the pattern already established by the two entered locations -
"LocationName":{
   "CanPlantHere": true
},

If it is the last location listed, the closing } must not have a comma after it .  Otherwise, include a comma . 
Here is a list of the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Location_data#:~:text=vanilla%20or%20custom).-,Location%20names,-In%2Dgame%20locations]location names[/url] .

If you want to get a little more advanced, here are some more properties you can list along with "CanPlantHere" .  Just like with the locations, all but the last line must end with a comma .  Behold :
"CanPlantHere": true,
"ChanceForClay": 0.03,
"CanHaveGreenRainSpawns": true,
"ArtifactSpots": [
                {
                    "Id": "(O)<item id number>",
                    "ItemId": " (O)<item id number> ",
                    "RandomItemId": null, (try setting to true if you're curious)
                    "MaxItems": null,
                    "MinStack": -1,
                    "MaxStack": -1,
                    "Quality": -1, (i'm pretty sure -1 means none)
                    "ObjectInternalName": null,
                    "ObjectDisplayName": null,
                    "ObjectColor": null,
                    "ToolUpgradeLevel": -1,
                    "IsRecipe": false,
                    "StackModifiers": null,
                    "StackModifierMode": 0,
                    "QualityModifiers": null,
                    "QualityModifierMode": 0,
                    "ModData": null,
                    "PerItemCondition": null,
                    "Condition": "!PLAYER_LOCATION_NAME Current Farm",
                    "Chance": 0.2,
                    "ApplyGenerousEnchantment": false, (true would be like enchanting your hoe with generous)
                    "OneDebrisPerDrop": false,
                    "Precedence": -100,
                    "ContinueOnDrop": true (whether the game rolls for more of the same item)
                },[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Audio#:~:text=on%20wood%20tiles.-,Music,-cue%20ID][/url]
],
"MusicDefault": null (you can replace "null" with any of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Audio#:~:text=on%20wood%20tiles.-,Music,-cue%20ID]these[/url] in quotes .)

You'll want to close this all off in a bracket } as it opened with one { after the location name .  The first link, with location names, has more information on this topic .
